study: J. Zhou, S. Ponce, J.-C. Charlier, High-throughput calculations of spin Hall conductivity in non-magnetic 2D materials, npj 2D Mater. Appl. 9, 39 (2025); Materials Cloud Archive record rfcdy-wcy32 (CC BY 4.0)

bands.limits: up to 1000 k-points; spin = true adds <sigma_x>, <sigma_y>, <sigma_z> of every band

band_edges.limits: mesh 12-300 (Gamma-centred N x N); returns max of band n, min of band n+1 and the smallest direct gap between them, with their k

wcc.limits: up to 201 k values, n_loop 20-300; Wilson loop of bands 1..n along reciprocal axis loop_axis at each reduced k of the other axis

shc.cost: ceil((N1*N2 + factor^2 * max_points) / 40000) + (number of spin components - 1)
shc.limits: mesh N1, N2 in 12-300 (Gamma-centred); N1*N2 + factor^2*max_points <= 160000; eta_eV 1e-4 to 0.05; up to 41 mu values; refine optional

parameters.spin: spin axes gamma among x, y, z (Cartesian axes of the archived cell)
parameters.eta_eV: constant broadening eta in the Kubo denominator (e_n - e_m)^2 + eta^2
parameters.position: how the velocity operator places the Wannier functions: "lattice" = at the lattice point of their home cell (the phase convention of aiida_hr.dat); "wannier_centres" = at their final centres in cut_aiida.wout (diagonal position operator)
parameters.refine: optional adaptive refinement as in Wannier90 berry_curv_adpt_kmesh: coarse points where the occupied spin Berry curvature exceeds threshold_A2 (Angstrom^2) for any requested spin and mu (at most max_points, largest first) are replaced by the average over a factor x factor sub-mesh of their mesh cell

shc.output: sigma^gamma_xy(mu) in Wannier90 units, (hbar/e) S/cm, computed with the volume of the archived cell (area x c, vacuum included), as in the archived aiida-shc-fermiscan.dat files

ribbon.limits: width * num_wann <= 1300; up to 31 k values; window width <= 0.6 eV; open ribbon finite along lattice vector finite_axis

archived_shc.limits: returns the archived aiida-shc-fermiscan.dat rows and the aiida.win of that folder

conventions.k: reduced coordinates of the reciprocal basis of CELL_PARAMETERS in aiida.in; k_z = 0
conventions.energies: eV on the energy scale of each archived calculation
conventions.bands: Wannier bands numbered from 1 (lowest Wannier band) within each model
conventions.hamiltonian: archived aiida_hr.dat with the use_ws_distance image selection of Wannier90 (as in the archived runs); it reproduces the archived aiida_band.dat
conventions.spin_operator: Pauli matrices on the spinor index of the Wannier functions (ordered 1 up, 1 down, 2 up, ...); the archive has no .spn file
conventions.spin_berry_curvature: Omega^gamma_n = sum_{m != n} -2 Im[<n|j^gamma|m><m|v_y|n>] / ((e_n - e_m)^2 + eta^2), j^gamma = {sigma^gamma, v_x}/2 (Qiao et al., PRB 98, 214402 (2018); Wannier90 berry_task = shc)
